scope: Run on Quest 3 and PICO 4; seated/standing and both hands. Editor tests and captures are separate evidence. Do not reuse 0.2.10 results.

checks.steps: Enter from Camp, consume the active tank, release input and keep tracking/focus valid. Observe Waiting for 3 eligible seconds and then slow fractional fill. Compare 20 seconds of active recovery against manual pumping.
checks.expected: About 5 units after the delay; no automatic shot, hand capture, recovery audio/haptics or requirement to wait before reaching free supply.

checks.steps: Hold a dry trigger/cannon input; then pause, lose hand tracking, recenter, enter a modal/shop, return to Camp and resume.
checks.expected: No recovery while blocked and no catch-up; each eligible return restarts the 3-second delay. Regained water cannot release a stored charge or fire a held dry trigger.

checks.steps: Recover in one owned loadout while racked, switch tools, perform manual supply, buy/tune equipment and upgrade a station, advance a sector and retry.
checks.expected: Only the active owned tank recovers; purchased tools start empty; no instant transition fill. Manual and recovered credits stay separate. Retry restores all tank and counter checkpoint values together.

checks.steps: Browse every tool, numeric tuning and offered station upgrade result using both hands. Confirm item name, model, price, operation description and action after rapid paging.
checks.expected: One correctly framed preview at a time; numeric tuning shows true before/after values and no invented new ability. Preview does not block price, Buy or Back and selecting it does not purchase/equip/refill.

checks.steps: Open/close and page repeatedly, test insufficient funds and already owned entries, lose tracking near controls and inspect missing-model fallback in QA.
checks.expected: No duplicate objects or callbacks, no physics/gameplay/audio/world emitters on preview, safe fallback and fresh same-hand pinch ownership.

checks.steps: Inspect both eyes on Quest 3 and PICO 4 while seated and standing; record frame cost while browsing versus the same scene without a visible preview.
checks.expected: Readable comfortable placement without lean or camera motion; no stereo disparity defects. Record actual PICO 4 frame/memory/overdraw data before performance acceptance.
